posts.title: I Published a Beta-Carotene Warning in 2008. I Didn't Know the Half of It.
posts.description: This is Episode 1 of the Beta-Carotene Case Files, a series on what the research actually shows about supplemental beta-carotene, how it's gone ignored for decades, and what it means for consumers, regulators, and professionals in the supplement, food, and beverage industries. This episode is an introductory background.

posts.title: What Would You Do with 6 Acres?
posts.description: We bought six acres in Northeast Oklahoma. Here's what I'm doing with it: maintaining health, digging into vitamin A and heavy metal toxicity, and eventually building a healthy food company.

posts.title: From WordPress to Astro: Zero Maintenance, Maximum Control
posts.description: I've moved this site from WordPress to the Astro framework, hosted on Cloudflare. Here's why and how I did it.
